tool.name: gnn_refine
tool.description: Protein structure refinement with GNNRefine using deep graph neural networks and PyRosetta FastRelax

param.name: input
param.label: Input PDB
param.description: Starting protein model in PDB format to refine

param.name: output_dir
param.label: Published output directory
param.description: Optional directory where the worker will copy the generated results

param.name: n_decoy
param.description: Number of decoys built in each iteration

param.name: n_proc
param.description: Number of parallel processes to use during refinement

param.name: device_id
param.description: Device id: -1 for CPU, >=0 for GPU

param.name: save_le_decoy
param.description: Save the lowest-energy decoy of each iteration

param.name: save_all_decoy
param.description: Save all decoy models generated during refinement

param.name: only_pred_dist
param.description: Only predict refined distance distributions without full relaxation

artifact.name: refined_models
artifact.label: Refined models
artifact.description: Refined PDB models and optional auxiliary outputs produced by GNNRefine
